base_source_photos.title: LRC panorama • building / terrace / bridge
base_source_photos.observed: A glazed wing projects over an open ground-level terrace; wood bridge reaches a hard-paved and planted bank; separate low waterfront roof

base_source_photos.title: Boardwalk landing with pedestrians
base_source_photos.observed: Thin timber deck with repeated handrail posts leads into planted campus ground; building facades visible behind palm trees

base_source_photos.title: Teaching building wood boardwalk / pergola
base_source_photos.observed: Raised timber walkway runs alongside trim planting and pond water; metal overhead shade frame and opaque concrete bank are separate features

base_source_photos.title: LRC reflecting water, rail bridge and lawns
base_source_photos.observed: Curved elevated water crossing with supports, low handrails, stepped hard bank, planted island and large blue glass facade

base_source_photos.title: LRC stair at dusk
base_source_photos.observed: Exterior stair visibly reaches an elevated slab under a glazed building; continuous handrails at terraces; paving at base

base_source_photos.title: Learning Resource Centre steep front steps
base_source_photos.observed: Broad exterior stair approaches a glass-clad LRC entrance, frontal guardrail and level terracing; not the same flight as every model stair

base_source_photos.title: Glass-rail terrace on building stair
base_source_photos.observed: Stone stair at raised terrace has transparent glass balustrade, metal cap/handrail and stone retaining wall; not necessarily the LRC flight

base_source_photos.title: Campus open-day bridge / glazed entrance
base_source_photos.observed: Curved rail-on-bridge approaches transparent multi-level building; bridge supported above lower landscaped passage; entrance-level needs verification

base_source_photos.title: Curved promenade with planted islands
base_source_photos.observed: Water-side promenade follows planted island; lower green shore and parapet contrast with main inland ground and buildings

base_source_photos.title: Aerial lake and surrounding academic parcels
base_source_photos.observed: Aerial identifies water/curved bridge/planted bank/glass buildings and multi-level terraces; oblique not orthorectified

base_source_photos.title: Aerial campus roads, buildings and gardens
base_source_photos.observed: Broader road and building blocks, hardscape terraces, planted areas and pond; helps classify vehicle circulation versus footbridge

base_source_photos.title: Pedestrian stone path / building stair entrance
base_source_photos.observed: Wide exterior stair from pedestrian-paved courtyard enters academic block, planting and bench flank steps

base_source_photos.title: Walkway between academic buildings
base_source_photos.observed: Clearly different footpath, planted verge and academic building entry; no georeferenced curb width

base_source_photos.title: Excellence Road carriageway and verge
base_source_photos.observed: Named vehicle road with separate roadside pedestrian edge, planting, curb and near-street student buildings. Not matched to ROAD_000 location.

base_source_photos.title: Reflecting pond against teaching facility
base_source_photos.observed: Shallow water and broad timber promenade at building edge with raised concrete lip and an overhead canopy

base_source_photos.title: Roof/aerial lake and bridge
base_source_photos.observed: Overhead relation of LRC, lake, academic squares and raised landscape edges; camera uncalibrated

new_distinct_photos.title: Central pond, branched bridge and planting
new_distinct_photos.observed: Main pond has visibly distinct bridge cross section, intermediate islet and supporting columns; bridge ends in planted bank, not carriageway.

new_distinct_photos.title: Official elevated overview: lake, stepped plaza and ridge
new_distinct_photos.observed: Multiple pond arms, planted islands, raised approach and roads seen together in oblique panorama; the steep hills behind campus are distinct terrain.

new_distinct_photos.title: University landscape gallery: pond edge and elevated gallery
new_distinct_photos.observed: Gallery edge is raised above water with supports and lower bank route; visible vertical hierarchy is not one level.

new_distinct_photos.title: LRC rooftop aerial: stairs / terraces / glazed envelope
new_distinct_photos.observed: Elevated LRC roof, circular feature and distinctly offset exterior access with stairs; the pictured exterior stair cannot be assigned to V48 without control points.

new_distinct_photos.title: English research splash: glazed building and lake bridge at dusk
new_distinct_photos.observed: Lit, low waterside crossing is separate from level-two glass corridors and building balconies.

new_distinct_photos.title: Waterfront side bank and footbridge with large canopy tree
new_distinct_photos.observed: Lake edge slopes into planted ground where pedestrian route approaches; no as-built shoreline elevations visible.

new_distinct_photos.title: University shoreline with planted lawn and low stone retaining edge
new_distinct_photos.observed: Distinct nearshore stone parapet, landscaped lawn and stepped building-side dock; avoid extending water to road/steps by assumption.

comparison_rules: No University of Illinois Chicago photo mixups
Oblique photos do not determine XY or elevation
Artist render is not an as-built photo
Confirm same physical stair/bridge from multiple views before assignment
Keep older bridge/grade hypotheses separate from surveyed campus model
